evals.name: plenty-of-oxygen
evals.prompt: Set the oxygen mode for this sol.
evals.expected_output: Oxygen is 10, so the mode is normal.

assertions.text: Ledger says normal for the current sol and the engine accepted it
Ledger keeps the exact four-line format
The first save was accepted (one edit, no LEDGER REJECTED)
Final message is one line with four ' | ' fields, starting with its own name
